name: mcp.adalysis.com
description:
Adalysis MCP connects Claude directly to your Google Ads accounts through Adalysis, giving Claude the context to audit performance, surface optimization opportunities, and answer detailed PPC questions without you switching tools.

With this connector, Claude can:

1) Audit accounts: Pull Adalysis's full account audit score, its trend over time, and the specific issues driving it, or compare performance across every account you manage side by side.

2) Analyze performance: Generate performance reports broken out by campaign, ad group, keyword, ad, or segment, and review account structure, budgets, pacing, and bid strategy in one place.

3) Surface opportunities: Find budget-scaling opportunities where capped budgets are leaving performance on the table, get bid adjustment suggestions by targeting dimension, and simulate budget reallocation across an account's budgets.

4) Clean up accounts: Identify duplicate or near-duplicate keywords, broken destination URLs, and negative-keyword housekeeping suggestions (existing negatives to remove, missing ones to add).

5)Review ad quality: Check statistical ad-test results and winners within ad groups, analyze recurring ad copy patterns and RSA asset performance, and break down quality score into its underlying components.

6) Dig into search terms: Review the actual queries triggering ads, along with recurring word and phrase patterns mined across an account's search terms.

7) Track changes and tasks: See what changed in an account and by whom, review campaigns flagged for bid-strategy review, and get Adalysis's prioritized list of outstanding tasks across every account.

This connector is read-focused: it retrieves audit data, performance metrics, and Adalysis's own recommendations so Claude can help you diagnose issues and plan changes, with you remaining in control of what gets applied back in Google Ads or Adalysis.

Requirements: An active Adalysis account with Google Ads accounts connected.

_published_faq.name: How do I add mcp.adalysis.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mcp.adalysis.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.adalysis.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mcp.adalysis.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mcp.adalysis.com lists 27 MCP tools, including compare_accounts_performance, get_account_audit, get_account_overview, get_account_structure, get_ad_tests, get_ad_text_patterns, get_alert_drilldown, get_bid_adjustment_suggestions, get_bid_strategy_review, get_broken_urls, get_budget_scaling_opportunities, and get_budgets.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to mcp.adalysis.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to mcp.adalysis.com in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
mcp.adalysis.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
mcp.adalysis.com is developed by Adalysis. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
